description: Research (web) and write docs/10_MODEL_AND_A100_PLAN.md comparing candidate models for low-latency control of the 8-DoF ST3215 arm with one 640x480 camera, hosted on one A100. First create git branch feat/a100-policy-server in normacore-hackathon (not main).
steps: git checkout -b feat/a100-policy-server (keep existing uncommitted team files untouched; stage only your own files)

Web research to verify current facts for: ACT, SmolVLA (LeRobot), Diffusion Policy, Pi0/Pi0.5 (openpi and LeRobot), NVIDIA GR00T N1.5/N1.6 (Isaac-GR00T policy server, embodiment tags, finetune data needs, VRAM), OpenVLA/OpenVLA-OFT, Octo, NVIDIA Cosmos / Cosmos-Reason, V-JEPA 2 (world model), Gemini Robotics-ER (already used), YOLO / Grounding DINO / OWL-ViT detectors. Note /home/laptop/src/GR00T-WholeBodyControl is a humanoid whole-body controller, probably not relevant; check quickly.

Write docs/10_MODEL_AND_A100_PLAN.md: comparison table (params, expected inference latency per action chunk on one A100 labelled estimate vs measured, demos needed, fit to 8-DoF arm + 1 camera, LeRobot compatibility, license), clear PICK plus FALLBACK. Hypothesis to validate: ACT primary (fast, ~50 demos, LeRobot native), SmolVLA or GR00T N1.5 as language-conditioned upgrade, Gemini ER-2 + YOLO stay as high-level perception. Include Mac->A100 network latency budget (action chunking hides RTT) and honest risks (elbow j3/j4 hardware problem, video decode problem in docs/08).
Add a short numbered user-steps section (A100 setup, record demos, upload dataset, lerobot-train command, start server, run client) pointing to files from FEAT-002/003
acceptance_criteria: docs/10_MODEL_AND_A100_PLAN.md exists with comparison table, pick, fallback, latency budget, user steps
Every model claim cites a source URL or is labelled estimate
verification: cat docs/10_MODEL_AND_A100_PLAN.md and confirm sections present; git branch --show-current prints feat/a100-policy-server
findings: Doc written and committed on feat/a100-policy-server. Verified via web: ACT (LeRobot docs), SmolVLA (450M, 20k steps ~4h A100, ~50 demos), openpi (inference >8GB, LoRA >22.5GB, full >70GB), Isaac-GR00T now N1.7 (inference 16GB+, finetune 40GB+, has policy server), V-JEPA 2 sizes. OpenVLA-OFT, Octo, Diffusion, Cosmos, detector rows are labelled estimates (pages did not match fetch). GR00T-WholeBodyControl is humanoid only. Guard 10 Hz limit noted for FEAT-003. Selftest not run (docs only).
